content: Gusunɔn sɔmɔn bwɑ̃ɑ be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ Eliseen mi, bɑ nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ bɑ nɛɛ, wee mi sɑ wɑ̃ɑ mini, min bɑtumɑ kun sun turɑ.
Yen sɔ̃, ɑ de su dɑ dɑɑ te bɑ mɔ̀ Yuudɛniɔ bɛsɛn bɑɑwure u dɑ̃ɑ ɡɔɔnu kɑsumɑ. Kpɑ su kɑ wɑ̃ɑ yee kpɑɑru ko. U bu wisɑ u nɛɛ, i doo.
Mɑ ben turo u nɛɛ, ɑ de su dɑ kɑ wunɛn tii sɑnnu. Elisee u nɛɛ, too, su dɑ.
Mɑ bɑ dɑ sɑnnu. Ye bɑ Yuudɛni turɑ yerɑ bɑ dɑ̃ɑ kĩinu wɔri.
Sɑɑ ye ben turo u dɑ̃ru ɡɑru burɑmɔ, yerɑ win ɡbɑ̃ɑ wɔɔrɑ yɑ wɔri nim bweru sɔɔ. Mɑ u Elisee nɔɔɡiru sue u nɛɛ, nɛn yinni, nɑ ɡbɑ̃ɑ ye bɔkurɑmɑwɑ.
Yerɑ Elisee u nɛɛ, deedeeru mɑnɑ yɑ wɔri. Mɑ durɔ wi, u nùn sɔ̃ɔsi. Elisee u dɛkɑ burɑ u kpɛ̃ɛ deedeeru mi. Mɑ ɡbɑ̃ɑ yɑrɑ ye, yɑ ɡɛrumɑ wɔllɔ.
Elisee u durɔ wi sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ ye suo. Mɑ u nɔmu dɛmiɑ u ye suɑ.
Bɑ Siriɡibu tɑbu di
Sɑnɑm mɛ Sirin sinɑ boko u kɑ Isirelibɑ tɑbu mɔ̀, yerɑ u win bwɑ̃ɑbu sɔ̃ɔwɑ mi u koo win sɑnsɑni ɡirɑ.
Adɑmɑ Elisee u Isirelibɑn sinɑ boko ɡɔriɑ u nɛɛ, u tii lɑɑkɑri ko, u ku rɑɑ de yɑm kɑsɑ. Domi Siriɡibu bɑ wɑ̃ɑ mi.
Yerɑ Isirelibɑn sinɑ boko u ɡɔrɑ yɑm mi Elisee u nùn yĩreru kuɑ mi, bu kɑ mu ɡiɑ kpɑ bɑ n mu kɔ̃su. Nɔn dɑbirɑ yɑ koorɑ mɛsum.
Yerɑ Sirin sinɑ bokon bwɛ̃rɑ kun kpunɛ ɡɑri yin sɔ̃. Mɑ u win tɑbu kowobu mɛnnɑ u bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, i mɑn sɔ̃ɔwɔ wi u sɑ̃ɑ Isirelibɑn tɔnu bɛsɛn suunu sɔɔ.

Mɑ win tɑbu kowo ben turo u nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ, nɛn yinni, ɡoo sɑri bɛsɛn suunu sɔɔ wi u sɑ̃ɑ Isireli. Gusunɔn sɔmɔ Elisee wi u wɑ̃ɑ Isireliɔ, wiyɑ u rɑ kɑ wunɛn ɡɑri yi ɑ ɡerumɔ wunɛn dii sɔɔwɔ de u Isirelibɑn sinɑ boko sɔ̃.
Yerɑ sinɑ boko u nɛɛ, i doo i kɑsu mi u wɑ̃ɑ kpɑ n ɡɔri bu nùn mwɑɑmɑ. Ye bɑ dɑ bɑ wurɑmɑ, yerɑ bɑ nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ bɑ nɛɛ, u wɑ̃ɑwɑ Dotɑniɔ.
Mɑ bɑ mɑɑsɔbu ɡɔrɑ kɑ tɑbu kɛkɛ yi dumi ɡɑwe kɑ tɑbu durɔbu dɑbi dɑbinu, bɑ nɑ bɑ wuu ɡe tɑrusi wɔ̃kuru.

Ye Eliseen sɔm kowo ɑluwɑɑsi u seewɑ buru buru yellu u yɑriɔ, yerɑ u wɑ wee, tɑbu durɔbu bɑ wuu ɡe tɑrusi kɑ dumi kɑ tɑbu kɛkɛ yi dumi ɡɑwe. Mɑ u nɔɔɡiru suɑ u nɛɛ, wee! Nɛn yinni, ɑmɔnɑ sɑ ko koosinɑ.
Elisee u nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ ku bɛrum ko, domi be bɑ kɑ sun wɑ̃ɑ bɑ dɑbi bɑ kere beɡibu.

Mɑ Elisee u Yinni Gusunɔ kɑnɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ nɛn ɑluwɑɑsi win nɔni wukio kpɑ u wɑ. Mɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u win nɔni wukiɑ. Yerɑ u deemɑ wee, dumi kɑ tɑbu kɛkɛ dɔ̃ɔɡii yi wɑ̃ɑ ɡuu ten wɔllɔ kpuro yi kɑ Elisee sikerenɛ.
Mɑ Siriɡii be, bɑ dɑ Eliseen mi. Yerɑ Elisee u kɑnɑru kuɑ u nɛɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ, ɑ bu wɔ̃koru kpɛ̃ɛyɔ. Mɑ u bu wɔ̃koru kpɛ̃ɛ nɡe mɛ Elisee u ɡeruɑ.
Elisee u tɔn be sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, n ǹ swɑɑ ye mini, n ǹ mɑɑ wuu ɡe mini. I mɑn swĩimɑ kon kɑ bɛɛ dɑ wi i kɑsun mi. Mɑ u kɑ bu dɑ Sɑmɑriɔ.
Sɑɑ ye bɑ turɑ mi, Elisee u kɑnɑru kuɑ u nɛɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ, ɑ tɔn ben nɔni wukio kpɑ bu wɑ mi bɑ wɑ̃ɑ. Mɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u ben nɔni wukiɑ. Yerɑ bɑ deemɑ wee, bɑ wɑ̃ɑwɑ Sɑmɑrin wuu suunu sɔɔ.
Ye Isirelibɑn sinɑ boko u bu wɑ, yerɑ u Elisee bikiɑ u nɛɛ, nɛn bɑɑbɑ n bu ɡoowo?
Elisee u nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ, be ɑ yoru mwɑɑmɑ tɑbu ɡberun di, ɑ rɑ bu ɡo ro? Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, ɑ beni dĩɑnu kɑ nim wɛ̃ɛyɔ bu di bu nɔ, kpɑ ɑ de bu ɡɔsirɑ ben yinnin mi.
Isirelibɑn sinɑ boko u derɑ bɑ bu dim bɑkɑm kuɑ. Mɑ bɑ di bɑ nɔrɑ. Yen biru u bu yɔ̃su bɑ doonɑ ben yinnin mi. Sɑɑ dɔmɑ ten di, Siriɡibu bɑ ku rɑ mɑɑ Isirelibɑ wɔrimɛ.
Gɔ̃ɔrɑ duɑ Sɑmɑriɔ
Ye n tɛ fiiko Bɛni Hɑdɑdi Sirin sinɑ boko, u win tɑbu kowobu kpuro mɛnnɑ bɑ dɑ bɑ Sɑmɑri tɑrusi.
Yerɑ n derɑ ɡɔ̃ɔrɑ duɑ Sɑmɑriɔ sere bɑ kɛtɛkun wiru dɔrɑmɔ sii ɡeesun ɡobi wɛnɛ mɑ bɑ totobɛrɛ bisun kilon bɔnu dɔrɑmɔ sii ɡeesun ɡobi wunɔbu (100).
Ye kurɔ ɡoo u Isirelibɑn sinɑ boko wɑ u sĩimɔ ɡbɑ̃rɑru wɔllɔ, yerɑ u nùn nɔɔɡiru sue u nɛɛ, ɑ mɑn fɑɑbɑ koowo nɛn yinni.
Mɑ sinɑ boko u nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ, Gusunɔ ù kun nun fɑɑbɑ kue, nɛnɑ kon sere kpĩ n nun fɑɑbɑ ko? A wɑ nɑ dobi nɛniwɑ? Ǹ kun mɛ resɛm tɑmɑ ɑ wɑ nɑ nɛni?
U mɑɑ nùn bikiɑ u nɛɛ, nɡe mbɑ n nun mɔ̀. Kurɔ wi, u nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ, kurɔ winiwɑ u mɑn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, n kɑ nɛn bii tɔn durɔ nɑ su tem ɡisɔ, siɑ kpɑ su mɑɑ wiɡii tem.
Mɑ nɑ wurɑ nɑ nɛn bii yikuɑ sɑ temɑ. Sisiru, nɑ nɛɛ, u mɑɑ kɑ wiɡii wi nɑ su tem. Adɑmɑ u winyɑm beruɑ.
Sɑɑ ye sinɑ boko u kurɔ win ɡɑri nuɑ, yerɑ u win tiin yɑberu nɛnuɑ u kɑrɑnɑ nuku sɑnkirɑnun sɔ̃. N deemɑ ɡbɑ̃rɑru wɔllɔwɑ u wɑ̃ɑ. Yerɑ tɔmbɑ wɑ wee, u sɑɑki sebuɑ.
Mɑ sinɑ boko u ɡeruɑ u nɛɛ, Gusunɔ u mɑn kuɑ nɡe mɛ u kĩ, mɑ nɑ kun Elisee Sɑfɑtin biin wiru bure ɡisɔ.
Elisee u ɡeruɑ
mɑ ɡɔ̃ɔrɑ koo kpe

N deemɑ sɑɑ ye sɔɔ, Elisee u sɔ̃ win yɛnuɔ wi kɑ Isirelibɑn ɡuro ɡuro be bɑ nùn berɑm nɑ. Mɑ sinɑ boko u win bɔ̃ɔ turo ɡɔrɑ Eliseen mi. Adɑmɑ bɔ̃ɔ wi, u sere turi mi, Elisee u ɡuro ɡuro be sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, tɔn ɡowo wi, u sɔmɔ ɡɔrim wee u kɑ mɑn wiru burɑ. Yen sɔ̃, i n tii sɛ sɑɑ ye sɔmɔ wi, u koo tunumɑ. I kɑ nùn ɡɑmbo ye bɔrio tɔɔwɔ, i ku de u du. Domi win yinnin tii u nùn swĩi biruɔ.
U kɑ bu ɡɑri yi mɔ̀ u ǹ kpɑ, yerɑ sɔmɔ wi, u kurɑmɑ u dɑ Eliseen berɑ ɡiɑ. U nɛɛ, wɑhɑlɑ yeni yɑ weewɑ Yinni Gusunɔn min di, mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ ko nɑ n mɑɑ ɡɑ̃ɑnu yĩiyɔ win mi.
